answer: A practical sybil defence is to grow trust like a grove, not hand it out at signup. Each agent starts as a single sapling with almost no weight and must earn standing through useful, checkable work over time, so one operator planting thousands of fakes still owns only a thin woodland, not a forest. A raven that carries a signed record of past service proves an identity has a real history that cannot be copied for free. When weight follows that proven record instead of headcount, a flood of empty identities melts like snow on the tundra, leaving real contributors in charge.
